Self-hosted browser builds (not loaded from a CDN at runtime).

- jsonrepair.min.js — jsonrepair 3.13.1, ISC
  https://github.com/josdejong/jsonrepair
- jsonpath-plus.umd.js — jsonpath-plus 10.3.0, MIT
  https://github.com/JSONPath-Plus/JSONPath
- jsonc-parser.umd.js — jsonc-parser (Microsoft), MIT
  https://github.com/microsoft/node-jsonc-parser
